proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D
  have key : ∀ W X Y Z : P, AffineMap.lineMap W (AffineMap.lineMap X (midpoint ℝ Y Z) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) -ᵥ A =
      (4⁻¹ : ℝ) • ((W -ᵥ A) + (X -ᵥ A) + (Y -ᵥ A) + (Z -ᵥ A)) := by
    intro W X Y Z
    have e1 : ∀ S T : P, ∀ r : ℝ, AffineMap.lineMap S T r -ᵥ A = (1 - r) • (S -ᵥ A) + r • (T -ᵥ A) := by
      intro S T r
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right T S A]
      module
    rw [e1, e1, midpoint_vsub, invOf_eq_inv]
    module
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
  · apply vsub_left_injective A
    simp only [key]
    congr 1
    abel
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), AffineMap.lineMap D (AffineMap.lineMap A (midpoint ℝ B C) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) = AffineMap.lineMap A (AffineMap.lineMap B (midpoint ℝ C D) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∧ AffineMap.lineMap D (AffineMap.lineMap A (midpoint ℝ B C) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) = AffineMap.lineMap B (AffineMap.lineMap C (midpoint ℝ D A) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∧ AffineMap.lineMap D (AffineMap.lineMap A (midpoint ℝ B C) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ) = AffineMap.lineMap C (AffineMap.lineMap D (midpoint ℝ A B) (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
